title: 第一卷 人生初见 第九章 有朋在远方第一卷 人生初见 第十章 长孙的请求
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
容颜大悦的长孙问天，拉着长孙的手，心里已经在为明天召开族会上，怎样狠狠的扇那些老家伙们的脸而谋划了。
长孙家乃是自己一人支撑才有了今天的位置，家族的继承人也必然由自己说了算。此刻多年前的霸气与张狂似乎又回到了长孙问天身上。
“孙儿，明日我便召开族会，到时我看谁还敢再反对我，哼！”长孙问天说道。
听到老爷子的话，长孙脸上露出一副果然如此的表情。
以长孙对老爷子的了解，如今自己可以修炼，老爷子必然会第一时间召开族会为自己正名，这不仅是为了自己，也是为了让这些年一直与老爷子唱反调的那些族老们闭嘴。
霸气依旧的老爷子啊，但却防不住岁月这把利刃。看着恢复当年神采的爷爷，长孙甚至有些不忍打断爷爷。
“爷爷，孙儿认为现在召开族会说出这一消息有些不妥。”长孙最终还是忍不住开口道。
听到长孙的话，老爷子忽然身子一顿，仿佛是忽然被浇了一盆冷水，定在了原地，仿佛大梦初醒一般。
感受到爷爷的变化，长孙忽然感觉此刻说出这话似乎不妥，但说出去的话也收不回来。长孙只能在心中盘算如何委婉的表达此刻爷孙二人在府内微妙却又尴尬的位置。
正当长孙准备开口的时候，长孙问天转过身来，满脸落寞又眼含愧疚的看着长孙。
长孙问天虽然年事已高，但脑子却依旧好使，如今自己虽然身处高位，但却恍若处在悬崖边上，稍有不慎就会跌入深渊。
长孙问天并不在乎自己的安危，但如今在这府上除了自己便再没有人能为长孙遮风挡雨了。
华夫人和南宫傲打的什么算盘其实长孙问天心里一直都很明白，但无奈的是长孙问天却无能为力。
望着爷爷满含愧疚的目光，长孙心中一怔，正欲开口说些什么，只见长孙问天抬起手，无力的摆了摆，示意长孙不用开口安慰他。
长孙问天背过身去，望向窗外的夜色，看着依然挺拔但却落寞的身影长孙心中一阵刺痛。
“孙儿，爷爷本应代你父母养育你平平安安长大成人的，但如今却让年少的你每日担惊受怕，实在是不该啊…”话语里的自责不仅刺痛着长孙问天，同时也让长孙一阵自责。
“爷爷，请你相信我，就像我从未怀疑过爷爷一样，孙儿会有自己的办法度过这次难关的。”长孙坚定的说道。
长孙问天转过身来看着长孙，心里感到甚是安慰，老天夺走了他的儿子，却没有打垮他的孙子，顿时一阵豪气油然而生，我长孙家的后代岂有孬货。
“好，孙儿，这次就让你我爷孙二人跟他们斗一斗，看这贼老天能不能打垮我。哈哈哈。”长孙问天畅快的大笑道。
看着爷爷一扫颓气，长孙也不自主的被爷爷感染。

……
长孙府的下人们近段时间都过得小心翼翼。
长孙老爷这两天时而脸色阴沉，时而又看着窗外哈哈大笑，下人们私下都传老爷的病估计越来越严重了，现在已经神志不清了。
长孙问天并不知道下人们如何评论自己，但他却知道自己此时是最清醒的时候。自己孙儿可以修炼，他算是几多欢喜几多忧，没想到自己在丽山南征北战这么多年，最后在自己的地界，自己的孙儿只能偷偷修炼，甚至走露消息便会性命不保，这怎能不让这位孤傲的老人不自责。
这几日长孙问天夜不能寐，终于在今日他才看到了转机。
在长孙问天年轻时，他给自己起下问天之名便是立下志向要行走于天下，寻问世间大道。
十年后回到丽山勘破天藏，御行于天，最终一统丽山，创下天行者。
但人们极少知道他曾经行走天下的事迹。自然也很少有人知道如今的落魄书生与长孙问天是生死之交。
其实长孙问天也已经有很多年没有跟自己这位老友联系了，只能从远方传来的消息中得知自己这位老友依然安好，还在坚持当年一起立下的誓言。
落魄书生名叫游子，家承名门宋家，只是宋家如今已成历史。而让宋家成为历史的就是游子。
那一夜游子一人一剑屠尽宋家上下三百余人，自此这一名门望族便消失于历史的尘埃中。
游子也是在那一夜向世人宣布他不再姓宋，从此无牵无挂，为游子。
content_en:
The happy-looking eldest grandson Wentian held his hand and was already planning how to slap those old guys in the face at the clan meeting tomorrow.
The eldest son's family is where it is today because of his own support, and he must have the final say on the family's heir. At this moment, the domineering and arrogance from many years ago seemed to have returned to Changsun Wentian.
"Grandson, I will hold a clan meeting tomorrow. Then I will see who dares to oppose me again, huh!" Changsun Wentian said.
After hearing the old man's words, the eldest grandson's face showed a true expression.
Based on the eldest grandson's understanding of the old man, and now that he can practice cultivation, the old man will definitely hold a clan meeting to clear his name as soon as possible. This is not only for himself, but also to silence the clan elders who have been against the old man all these years.
The old man is still domineering, but he cannot guard against the sharp blade of time. Looking at his grandfather who had regained his former glory, the eldest grandson even couldn't bear to interrupt his grandfather.
"Grandpa, my grandson thinks it's inappropriate to hold a clan meeting now to tell the news." The eldest grandson finally couldn't help but said.
After hearing what the eldest grandson said, the old man suddenly froze, as if a basin of cold water had been poured on him suddenly, and he froze in place, as if he had just woken up from a big dream.
Feeling the change in his grandfather, the eldest grandson suddenly felt that it seemed inappropriate to say these words at this moment, but he could not take back what he said. The eldest grandson could only think about how to tactfully express the subtle but embarrassing position of the grandfather and grandson in the house at this moment.
Just when the eldest grandson was about to speak, eldest grandson Wentian turned around and looked at the eldest grandson with a lonely face and guilty eyes.
Although Changsun Wentian is old, his brain is still good. Although he is in a high position now, he seems to be on the edge of a cliff. If he is not careful, he will fall into the abyss.
The eldest grandson Wentian doesn't care about his own safety, but now there is no one in this house except himself who can protect his eldest grandson from the wind and rain.
In fact, Changsun Wentian had always known what Mrs. Hua and Nangong Ao had planned, but unfortunately Changsun Wentian was helpless.
Looking at his grandfather's guilt-filled eyes, the eldest grandson was startled. Just as he was about to say something, eldest grandson Wentian raised his hand and waved it feebly, signaling that the eldest grandson did not need to speak to comfort him.
Changsun Wentian turned his back and looked out the window at the night. Looking at the still upright but lonely figure, Changsun felt a pain in his heart.
"Grandson, grandpa should have raised you up safely on behalf of your parents, but now he makes you worry and be afraid every day. It really shouldn't be..." The self-blame in his words not only stung the eldest grandson Wentian, but also made the eldest grandson blame himself for a while.
"Grandpa, please believe me, just like I have never doubted grandpa, my grandson will have his own way to get through this difficulty." The eldest grandson said firmly.
Changsun Wentian turned around and looked at his eldest grandson, feeling very comforted in his heart. God took away his son, but did not defeat his grandson. Suddenly, a burst of pride arose spontaneously. The descendants of my eldest grandson's family are not bad.
"Okay, grandson, let me and my grandson fight with them this time to see if this thief can defeat me. Hahaha." Changsun Wentian laughed heartily.
Seeing his grandfather lose his temper, the eldest grandson was involuntarily infected by his grandfather.
…
The servants of Changsun Mansion have been living cautiously recently.
In the past two days, Master Changsun has sometimes looked gloomy, and sometimes looked out the window and laughed. People among the servants secretly said that the master's illness is probably getting worse and he is now unconscious.
Changsun Wentian didn't know how his servants would comment on him, but he knew that he was the most sober at this time. He was both happy and worried that his grandson could practice cultivation. He did not expect that after so many years of fighting in Lishan, his grandson could only practice secretly in his own land. Even if the news was revealed, his life would be in danger. How could this aloof old man not blame himself?.
Changsun Wentian couldn't sleep at night these past few days, and finally he saw a turning point today.
When Changsun Wentian was young, he named himself Wentian because he made up his mind to travel around the world and find the way to the world.
Ten years later, he returned to Lishan to explore the Tianzang, travel in the sky, and finally unified Lishan and became a Skywalker.
But few people know that he once traveled around the world. Naturally, few people know that today's down-and-out scholar and the eldest grandson Wentian are close friends of life and death.
In fact, Changsun Wentian has not contacted his old friend for many years. He can only know from the news from afar that his old friend is still well and still adheres to the vows we made together back then.
The down-and-out scholar is named Youzi, and his family belongs to the famous Song family, but the Song family has now become history. And it was the wanderers who made the Song family history.
That night, the wanderer slaughtered more than 300 members of the Song family with one sword and one man. From then on, this famous family disappeared into the dust of history.
It was also on that night that Youzi announced to the world that his surname was no longer Song, and he was free from worries and became Youzi.
